post.description:
OAuth login endpoint.

Verify OAuth token, create/update user, and issue JWE tokens.
Refresh access token using refresh token.

Refresh Supabase token for the browser extension.

Proxies the refresh request to Supabase so the extension does not need
the Supabase client library.  The refresh_token itself serves as the
authentication credential (same pattern Supabase uses).

Logout endpoint.

Client should remove tokens from localStorage.

delete.description:
Permanently delete the current user's account and all associated data.

This endpoint:
1. Deletes the user row from the database (cascades to articles, subscriptions, etc.)
2. Returns 204 No Content on success.

The client is responsible for calling supabase.auth.signOut() and clearing
local tokens/cache after receiving a successful 204 response.

App Store Guideline 5.1.1(v) compliance: users initiated from the mobile app
can fully delete their account via this endpoint.

ValidateReceiptRequest.title: ValidateReceiptRequest
ValidateReceiptRequest.description:
Mobile client → server: validate an IAP receipt or purchase token.

Apple:
- ``receipt_data``: base64-encoded StoreKit 1 receipt (legacy)
- ``transaction_id``: StoreKit 2 originalTransactionId (preferred)

Google:
- ``purchase_token``: purchase token returned by the Play Billing Library
- ``product_id``: subscription product ID (e.g. ``nod_pro_monthly``)
- ``package_name``: Android application ID (default ``com.nod.app``)

ValidateReceiptResponse.description: Server → mobile client: result of validating an IAP receipt.
